Definition: of uncertain affinity; clean (literally or figuratively):--clean, clear, pure.
BiblicalUsage: Clean is the word for the pure in heart who shall see God, and for the branches made clean through the word He has spoken, and for the love that comes out of a pure heart and a good conscience and faith unfeigned, and for the religion that is pure before God. The word holds the heart, the branch, the conscience, and the religion together, and all of them are clean the same way: washed by the word and kept by grace.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the pure in heart shall see God, and that promise is worth every washing. I hold that purity is not a performance but a cleansing, and the clean heart is the one He has made clean.
